Definition: Kinneroth or Kinnereth, a place in Palestine
BiblicalUsage: Chinnereth is a place in Palestine, the sea and the plain beside it. Numbers 34:11 sets the border of the land at the side of the sea of Chinnereth, Deuteronomy 3:17 names Chinnereth as the northern edge of the plain down to the salt sea, and Joshua 11:2 places kings south of Chinneroth among those Joshua fought.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe the sea of Chinnereth is the same water Jesus would walk and preach beside: the border of the old land became the shore of the new teaching.
Sources: Strong's Exhaustive Concordance (1890), via OpenScriptures Strong's Dictionary (CC BY-SA)
